tasks.description: In `orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py`, add `_cleanup_stale_generic_drafts(worktree_path)` that removes `.egg-state/drafts/analysis.md` and `.egg-state/drafts/plan.md` using `git rm -f` + `git commit` directly (NOT _commit_statefiles_to_worktree, which only stages {pid}-prefixed files). Fall back to os.unlink for untracked files. Call after `_sync_worktree_with_remote` at ~line 5934, then push.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: When a pipeline starts on a branch with stale .egg-state/drafts/analysis.md, the generic file is removed and the deletion is committed; prefixed files like 1553-analysis.md are untouched.

tasks.description: In `orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py:_read_phase_draft()`, add `logger.debug` when `draft_path.exists()` returns False, logging the attempted path, phase, issue_number, and pipeline_id.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: When _read_phase_draft can't find a draft, the debug log includes the full attempted path.

tasks.description: In `orchestrator/tests/test_read_phase_draft.py`, add tests for _cleanup_stale_generic_drafts (removes generic files, preserves prefixed files, no-op when no drafts dir) and _read_phase_draft debug logging on missing files.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All new tests pass and cover cleanup and logging behavior.

pr.title: Fix stale generic drafts persisting on work branches
pr.description:
Clean up legacy unprefixed draft files (analysis.md, plan.md) at pipeline
start and add diagnostic logging when draft reads fail silently.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new tests in test_read_phase_draft.py for cleanup function and debug logging
- Manual: start a pipeline on a branch with stale analysis.md, verify it's removed before agents run
